description: Derive a list of candidate file-glob patterns for a codebase query. Quoted file names referenced in the query (single or double quoted, of the form name.ext) become explicit '**/<name.ext>' patterns. Language-family patterns are then appended whenever the lower-cased query contains the corresponding trigger substrings (e.g. rust/.rs, javascript/js/node/react, typescript/ts/angular/next, python/py/django/flask, go/golang, c++/cpp/' c '/.c, java but not javascript). If no source-directory ('**/src/...') pattern has been added, four default source-directory patterns are appended; finally a '**/*.rs' pattern is guaranteed to be present. Patterns are emitted one per line in the order produced, including any duplicates.
